text_blocks.snippet: In May 2021, Elon Musk, CEO of Tesla, tweeted that the company would suspend vehicle purchases using Bitcoin due to environmental concerns related to Bitcoin mining and transaction energy consumption, particularly citing coal. He stated that Tesla would not sell its existing Bitcoin holdings but would resume Bitcoin transactions once mining transitioned to more sustainable energy. This announcement caused a significant drop in Bitcoin's price.
